PM Modi Gifts Traditional Indian Art and Crafts to World Leaders

Prime Minister Narendra Modi presented traditional Indian art and craft items as gifts to several world leaders. Among these were a golden Pichwai painting, originating from Nathdwara, Rajasthan, gifted to the U.S. president. The Prime Minister of Australia, Anthony Albanese, received a blue Jaipur pottery artefact. Other gifts included a Banarasi Katan silk stole and a Kashmiri carpet.
